notes.title: Play the 100 in 1 Game Collection Demo!
notes.notes:
[h3]The 100 in 1 demo is NOW LIVE! 🎉 [/h3]

Download, play and share your experience with us! We can't wait to see the fun you have. 

The demo features the first island where you'll experience 8 games:

[list]
[*] Fruit Snake
[*] Chicken Day
[*] Astaria Defender
[*] Pac Sheep
[*] Toucan Flight
[*] Monkeyzooka
[*] Buglock

[/list]

We'll have the demo live until launch on June 19, so you better act fast if you want to try it out.

Most important, please Wishlist 100 in 1 if you haven't!

notes.title: 100 in 1 Games Collection – Coming to PAX East
notes.notes:
We're bringing 100 in 1 Games Collection to PAX East this year (May 8-11 in Boston)! It's packed with creative mini-games - some quick, some challenging, all made with love. If you're at the show, come play a few rounds and share your thoughts. [b]We'll be at Booth 15078[/b] -  It's right next to the Pokemon stand. We would genuinely love to chat with you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45514209/084304e4b2dab816e3d720c602e3c0d41a3ca220.png[/img]

notes.title: 100 in 1 Game Collection Now Launching June 19
notes.notes:
Hi all, 

We've been working hard to deliver an amazing collection of games for you, but as anyone who has made a game before knows, it's no easy task. This is why we've made the tough decision to take a little more time to polish 100 in 1 Game Collection and move the game's release to June 19, 2025. This will give us the proper time to continue improving the quality of the gameplay for the best experience possible.

Thank you all for your support of 100 in 1 Game Collection!
